requirements.text: Roles map to permissions, with inheritance validated when roles are defined
A check denies unless an unexpired assignment grants the permission; denies override allows
Assignments never cross tenants, and a resource-scoped role applies only to that resource
Granting or revoking roles needs a manage permission and cannot escalate the actor's own access
The last owner of a tenant cannot be removed, including under concurrent revokes
Request handlers can require a permission and return 401/403

evidence.name: role definitions are validated at creation
grant and revoke need rbac:manage and cannot escalate
last-owner protection on PostgreSQL, including concurrent revokes

implementations.notes: OpenFGA check adapter and Cedar policy: relationship/policy engines rather than a role table
